parsed.rationale: Both `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 42 in RadioPlayerMessages.swift) and `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 38 in HLSPlayerMessages.swift) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Because the bodies are identical and both types presumably conform to a shared message protocol (given the parallel naming convention `*RateDidChangeMessage`), the implementation belongs in a protocol extension default rather than repeated in each conformer. Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is safe. Placing the default implementation in a new file `Playback/Messages/PlayerMessage+Defaults.swift` keeps it within the same SPM package as both conformers.
